selection_reason: custom validation functions object -> hasOwnProperty check -> prevents prototype pollution in function registry
source_summary: custom parameter passed to Inspection constructor, merged from Validation.custom/Sanitization.custom and user-provided custom object
sink_summary: this._custom object used to store and execute user-defined validation/sanitization functions via .call() with schema and data parameters
guard_summary: hasOwnProperty check prevents prototype pollution by ensuring only own properties of custom object are copied, not inherited properties from Object.prototype
risk_pattern: Without hasOwnProperty check, attacker could inject properties into Object.prototype that would be copied to _custom object and executed as validation/sanitization functions with access to schema and user data
called_function_context: _custom functions are called with .call(this, schema, candidate/post) giving them access to validation context and user data
enclosing_conditions: if (custom != null) wrapper around the for-in loop
context_summary: The hasOwnProperty check prevents prototype pollution attacks where malicious properties added to Object.prototype would be copied to the _custom registry and executed as validation/sanitization functions with access to sensitive schema validation logic and user data.
unresolved_facts: Exact source of user-provided custom parameter to Validation/Sanitization constructors
Whether Validation.custom and Sanitization.custom are user-configurable
Specific attack vectors that could exploit prototype pollution in this validation library context
